name: Aadhaar Card
purpose: Primary biometric unique identification proof issued by UIDAI for Indian residents.

name: PAN Card
purpose: Permanent Account Number required for financial transactions and income tax filing.

name: Voter ID Card (EPIC)
purpose: Official photo identity proof for electoral participation and residency.

name: Passport
purpose: International travel document and definitive identity/citizenship proof.

name: Driving Licence
purpose: Permit to operate motor vehicles and official photo ID.

name: Birth Certificate
purpose: Official record establishing date, time, and place of birth.
issuingAuthority: Municipal Corporation / Registrar of Births & Deaths

name: Income Certificate
purpose: Validates annual family income for subsidy schemes, reservations, and fee waivers.

name: Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
purpose: Proof of belonging to SC, ST, or OBC category for reservations and schemes.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
purpose: Establishes permanent state residence for state-specific schemes and quota.

name: Ration Card (APL/BPL/AAY)
purpose: Family composition proof for subsidized food grains and welfare coverage.
issuingAuthority: Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs

name: Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
purpose: Proof of bank account, IFSC code, and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) routing.

name: Disability Certificate (UDID)
purpose: Unique Disability ID establishing degree of physical or mental disability.
issuingAuthority: Medical Board / Department of Disability Affairs

name: Marriage Certificate
purpose: Legal proof of marriage for joint applications and spousal pensions.

name: Electricity Bill
purpose: Utility proof establishing current residential address.

name: Water Bill
purpose: Municipal utility proof for physical residency validation.

name: Property Tax Receipt / Khata
purpose: Establishes legal land/house ownership and valuation status.

name: Land Patta / Khasra-Khatauni
purpose: Proof of agricultural landholding size and land rights for farmers.
issuingAuthority: State Land Records Department / Revenue Patwari

name: Class 10th Marksheet / Passing Certificate
purpose: Educational background proof and widely accepted age proof.

name: College Graduation Degree Certificate
purpose: Proof of higher education qualification for competitive schemes.

name: Salary Slip / Form 16
purpose: Proof of employment and income validation for working individuals.

name: GST Registration Certificate
purpose: Proof of business entity registration for micro and MSME loans.

name: Udyam MSME Registration Certificate
purpose: Official recognition for micro, small, and medium enterprises.
issuingAuthority: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises

name: ITR Verification Acknowledgement
purpose: Proof of annual tax filing for business credit and subsidy audit.

name: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC)
purpose: Official ownership proof of motor vehicle.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Card
purpose: Provides cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per family.

name: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)
purpose: Background check document for passport, employment, and security clearance.

name: DigiLocker Verified Account Badge
purpose: Unified digital repository proof legally equivalent to original physical documents under IT Act.
issuingAuthority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

name: Passport Size Photograph
purpose: Recent photograph required for official identification on scheme applications.

name: Digital Signature Sample
purpose: Signature image for application verification and document authentication.
